pokedexEntries.di: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

pokedexEntries.prl: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.pt: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
